post.summary: Terminate all sessions for a user (admin only).
post.description:
Revokes all refresh tokens, deactivates all devices, and suspends
the user account. The next request from that user will return 401.

post.summary: Activate an agent account by validating OTP and registering device public key
Step 1 of the challenge-response refresh flow.
post.description:
Validates the refresh token, generates a nonce, stores it in Redis,
and returns it to the client for signing.

post.summary: Step 2 of the challenge-response refresh flow.
post.description:
Verifies the signed nonce against the device's registered public key,
then issues a new access token.
